Ikena Kai

Your Ocean View Retreat in Paradise
Kihei, Maui

Reserve Your Stay

Welcome to our home in Kihei. A place where the trade winds carry the scent of tropical flowers and the Pacific stretches out before you. Whether you're here to explore the island or just slow down by the pool, this is where Maui happens on your terms.

The Property

Your Stay

Amenities

  • Infinity Pool & Spa — 40-foot pool with gradual entry, heated spa with jets. Pool toys in the storage bench.
  • Guest Cottage — Detached 2-bedroom unit with private entrance, full bathroom, and its own AC.
  • Open Lanai — 24-foot pocket sliding doors open the living room to the pool deck.
  • Outdoor Shower — Hot and cold water — perfect for rinsing off after the beach.
  • Media Room — Surround sound with streaming. Movie nights hit different in Maui.
  • Multi-Zone AC — Central AC with controls in every room.
  • Chef's Kitchen — Gas range, full appliances, coffee maker, and spices already stocked.
  • WiFi — IkenaKai_Guest network. Password from Grant.

House Rules

  • Check-in: Grant will give you the front door code
  • No smoking inside the house
  • No pets without prior approval
  • Quiet hours after 10 PM
  • Rinse off sand before coming inside
  • No glass by the pool
  • Parking: Driveway fits 2 cars + carport
